description: AI Buddy can brings conversational AI directly into Power BI reports. AI Buddy by iFour Visual is an interactive visual component that connects to AI platforms (currently Azure OpenAI) to provide dynamic, real-time conversational support directly within your reports. visual allows users to ask questions,data Interpretation, and receive summaries or explanations—all without leaving the Power BI environment. With full customization of API settings, header design, and chat styling, AI Buddy integrates seamlessly with your branding and business needs. Key features AI-Powered Chat Integration-: Connect to Azure OpenAI (or other supported platforms) to enable natural language queries, explanations, and summaries within Power BI. Previous Chat History Management-: Support user-facing chat history Allows regeneration or summarization of previous interactions Azure OpenAI Token Management-: No setup required — our visual manages Azure OpenAI (GPT) tokens on your behalf based on your subscription level Transparent Usage Tracking Daily Usage Metrics: Track how many tokens your users consume per day Cumulative Token Count: Monitor total tokens used during your billing cycle Secure API Configuration-: Set up your AI service securely using API keys and custom endpoints, ensuring flexibility and control over your AI backend.
